exposure: Preoperative vaginal cleansing with chlorhexidine 0.25% antiseptic wipes
cohort: 218 pregnant women scheduled for term elective cesarean section
finding: Preoperative vaginal cleansing with chlorhexidine 0.25% antiseptic wipes significantly reduced the rate of post-cesarean infectious morbidities, specifically endometritis.
mod_finding: Preoperative vaginal cleansing with chlorhexidine 0.25% antiseptic wipes significantly reduced the rate of post-cesarean infectious morbidities, specifically endometritis.
